biggest_catch: The friend has just 30 days to deposit $100 into the new checking account AND activate the debit card - miss that window and neither of you gets the $50.
catches: Referrer must have an active Wings account in good standing; both referrer and friend must be 18+.

Friend must: qualify for membership (CO counties served, CO National Guard/Buckley AFB personnel, or family of members), open a $5 share savings account, and open a new No Strings Checking or Broncos Checking account.
Within 30 days: friend deposits $100 into the new checking account and activates the debit card.
Reward: $50 electronic gift card (Visa or Amazon digital) to both referrer and friend; redemption emails sent within 5 business days of compliance verification.
No referral limits - refer as many 18+ non-members as you like.
Friends eligible for only one reward redemption; employees, officials, and affiliates ineligible.
Gift cards subject to applicable taxes.
Program terms at ent.com/legal/refer; no fixed expiry stated.

steps: Share your Wings referral with a friend who is 18+ and not already a Wings member.
Friend joins (CO field of membership), opens a $5 share savings and a No Strings or Broncos Checking account.
Friend deposits $100 into the checking account and activates the debit card within 30 days.
You both receive emails within 5 business days to redeem your $50 digital gift card (Visa or Amazon).
timing: Reward redemption emails sent within 5 business days after verification of compliance.
when_cash_arrives: Redemption email within 5 business days after verification of compliance. Your friend deposits $100 into the new checking account and activates the debit card - both startable the day the account opens.
maximize: Have the friend deposit the $100 when opening the checking account online and activate the debit card as soon as it arrives - the 30-day window is a deadline, not a wait.
Digital redemption (email) is far faster than the 4-6-week mailed-card programs.
The friend must be new to Wings (formerly Ent); debit-card mailing time is the one variable you cannot control.

speed_history.rationale: Official terms: redemption email within 5 business days of verification; the friend's steps (deposit $100, activate debit card) start the day the account opens.
